name: Gebrechen
source:
Joe is an old and experienced hero. After losing his family, he has entered a completely unknown world full of demons and dark mysteries.

He only has three things left; his (not so) faithful magic spear, a pact with a mysterious entity, and his daughter Faith.

In a world that has no right choices, only the least bad ones. Will he be able to play with fate to find a happy ending for his daughter?

[Edited from [url=https://carpe-diem-game-devs.itch.io/gebrechen]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
乔是一位经验丰富的老英雄。失去家人后，他进入了一个完全未知的世界，充满了恶魔和黑暗的谜团。

他只剩下三件事了：他的（不那么）忠实的魔法长矛，与神秘实体的契约，以及他的女儿费丝。

在这个世界上，没有正确的选择，只有最不坏的选择。他能否玩弄命运，为女儿找到幸福的结局？

[编辑自[url=https://carpe-diem-game-devs.itch.io/gebrechen]Itch.io[/url]]
